items.title: YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge
items.summary: YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge is a JavaScript tool that aims to bypass security restrictions (jailbreak) using customizable prompts for different AI models. The project allows users to define their own commands for different models and focuses on local models by default.

items.title: mlabonne/llm-course
items.summary: mlabonne/llm-course is a comprehensive educational resource containing roadmaps and Colab notebooks for those who want to get started in the field of Large Language Models (LLMs). This project offers a curriculum that guides those who want to learn artificial intelligence models from basic to advanced levels.

snapshot.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.

items.title: Kruk2/jasna
items.summary: Kruk2/jasna is a video restoration tool developed to improve videos. Written in Python, this project automates the technical processes aimed at increasing image quality.

items.title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
items.summary: ComfyUI is a modular image generation tool that offers a node-based interface for diffusion models. Running on local systems, this software allows users to visualize complex workflows and run models via API with its graph-based structure.

snapshot.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.

items.title: Someone behind the software
items.summary: This article, which addresses the visibility of the human factor and personal effort in software development processes, focuses on the stories of the individuals behind digital products. Beyond technical achievements in the software world, it emphasizes the importance of understanding the motivations and experiences of the people who build these tools.

items.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
items.summary: Hybrid Reasoning Agents are Large Language Models (LLMs) that have the ability to think in latent space and perform their actions based on text. This approach aims to integrate complex reasoning processes into artificial intelligence agents.

items.title: RepRapMicron
items.summary: RepRapMicron is a compact manufacturing device developed as part of the self-replicating 3D printer project, RepRap. The project offers a small-scale printer design capable of producing its own hardware parts.

items.title: There's never been a better time to go into math (by: 3blue1brown) [video]
items.summary: The 3blue1brown channel, which produces mathematics content, has released a video discussing why now is the best time to pursue the field of mathematics. The content evaluates how mathematical thinking and career opportunities in this field have changed with current technological developments.

items.title: macOS 15.8.2 Breaks OpenGL
items.summary: The macOS 15.8.2 update is causing technical issues with the graphics processing library OpenGL. Users report that OpenGL-based applications are not working properly with this version of the operating system.

items.title: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy
items.summary: flux-3-image-klein-comfy, developed by Black Forest Labs, is an artificial intelligence model that enables image-to-image transformation. It provides a structure that allows users to generate new outputs based on existing images.

items.title: AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face discusses the use of artificial intelligence in humanitarian aid tasks such as disaster response and displacement tracking. The study examines how satellite imagery and socioeconomic data can be analyzed using machine learning algorithms to produce data-driven solutions to global challenges.

items.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
items.summary: Xiaomi-Lens-0 is a 4-billion parameter model developed to address the shortcomings of multimodal large language models in understanding visual details. Built on Qwen3.5, this system performs mask prediction based on visual representations, allowing for more precise analysis of specific regions within an image.

snapshot.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer questions about whole images well, yet they still struggle with fine-grained region understanding. A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer. To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations. items.title: MTEdit: Packed Trajectories Beat Rollouts for Multi-Turn Image Editing
items.summary: MTEdit, shared by Hugging Face, is a dataset aimed at reducing error accumulation and visual-quality drift in multi-stage image editing processes. Unlike traditional sequential processing methods, it aims to improve human-AI collaborative editing processes by using packed trajectories.

snapshot.description: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, making it better aligned with human-AI collaborative creation than single-turn editing. However, constructing high-quality multi-turn training data remains challenging, as conventional sequential rollout accumulates errors and introduces visual-quality drift across editing turns. items.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
items.summary: LiveMACEBench is a benchmark tool that evaluates the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through a process-oriented approach across volatile financial markets. This system focuses not only on the results agents achieve but also on the processes they use to generate those results and their ability to adapt to external conditions.

snapshot.description: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. items.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
items.summary: Scene-Designer is an artificial intelligence framework designed to create 3D interior scenes from natural language. The system aims to increase the consistency and usability of scenes by combining design and critique processes.

snapshot.description: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong design intelligence: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes.
